reached_sql:
WITH date_sk_set AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
)
SELECT w.w_state, i.i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(dd.d_date AS date) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
                ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(dd.d_date AS date) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
                ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM item i
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_sk_set ds ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
                            AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
  AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
